tools.name: text_analyze
tools.description: Use this when you need deterministic text analysis (counts, Flesch readability, script mix, top keywords). Pay-per-call: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 to the REST route POST /v1/text/analyze.

tools.name: hook_score
tools.description: Use this when you need a gaming headline or hook scored 0-100 against the 369 team's hook rules. Pay-per-call: $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 to the REST route POST /v1/hook/score.

tools.name: translate_check
tools.description: Use this when you need an EN<->FA translation QA score 0-100 (numbers/entities preserved, script purity, untranslated segments). Pay-per-call: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402 to the REST route POST /v1/translate/check.

tools.name: game_facts
tools.description: Use this when you need live game metadata from RAWG (release date, ratings, Metacritic, platforms, genres). Pay-per-call: $0.03 USDC on Base via x402 to the REST route POST /v1/game/facts.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: translate_check · Public sink: text_analyze, hook_score, translate_check, game_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: translate_check · Public sink: text_analyze, hook_score, translate_check, game_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
